summary: @servicetitan/standalone-feature-flags preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs an obfuscated setup.mjs that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub, extracts and chmods the binary, and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated sibling file `math_init.js`. setup.mjs itself uses hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`,...) and string-property indirection to hide the download-extract-execute chain. math_init.js is a Bun-CJS bundle using rotated string-array obfuscation, character-code decoders, and hex-mangled identifiers, with no readable strings tying it to the package's advertised OpenFeature/LaunchDarkly feature-flag wrapper purpose. Installing the package on any developer or CI host causes an opaque payload to be run under a freshly downloaded alternate language runtime, bypassing Node-based static scanners. The combination of alternate-runtime delivery, install-time auto-execution, heavy obfuscation of both the loader and the payload, and a purpose mismatch with the advertised feature-flag wrapper is the alternate-runtime-dropper attack shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
